how_to_measure_true_lift: Set ab.holdout_pct (e.g. 10) in config.yaml. The on-start hook then serves a generic opening to that share of GLIDs (hash-assigned, stable) and logs arm + on-end disposition; rerun `python -m gcx eval lift` after ~1 week of calls and compare meeting-fixed / talk-time between arm=personalised and arm=control.
